chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from one who narrated to him, from one of the two (Imams) عليهما السلام, that he was asked about the time of Maghrib, so he said:
When its kursiyy disappears. I said: And what is its kursiyy? He said: Its disk. So I said: When does its disk disappear? He said: When you look toward it and do not see it.

key_terms.غَابَ: disappeared or went out of sight
key_terms.فَلَمْ تَرَهُ: then you did not see it
key_terms.قُرْصُهَا: its disk, meaning the round visible body of the sun
key_terms.كُرْسِيُّهَا: a term explained here as referring to the sun’s visible disk
key_terms.وَقْتِ الْمَغْرِبِ: the time of the Maghrib prayer

ai.seo_question: When does the time of Maghrib begin according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the beginning of the time of Maghrib prayer. It states that Maghrib begins when the sun’s disk has disappeared from sight, giving a practical sign for determining the time.
